reviews.comment: This class had an unusual topic for the readings (fungi), but overall, Prof. Seacrest was great! She is always open for office hours and is very understanding if you need an extension. There's a lot of reading/ discussion in this class, so it requires a lot of time, but it's not hard AT ALL to receive an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's def a bit of a character (like any lit prof), but she's great at teaching and providing feedback on essays and other homework. The class itself can kinda be a pain if you're not into discussions about the subject, but it's really not bad. She grades pretty easy as long as you put in SOME effort. Take her!

TAKE ENVI LIT! ENGL 202 I absolutely loved this class! My favorite class I've taken at A&M! Easy and interesting lit credit. Take if you enjoy the environment or human impact on it. She's willing to work with you and is so hands on and helpful. Most of class is just discussion about what we read what is assigned. She's very educated and passionate

Professor Secreast is unique in the way she teaches with a classroom built around respect, productive and exciting debate, and a thorough understanding of varying topics. She is amazing at encouraging students and gives amazing feedback to improve your writing potential.  Take this course!!
Take this class!!! She gives amazing feedback and loves what she does. She will also work with you on due dates if you need them pushed back
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Seacreast is the most caring and understanding professor I have ever had. We had a fair amount of homework in this class, but they didn't take took too long besides the 4 required essays. My class was an 8am, but Prof Secreast was able to keep us all engaged. My only complaint is that we had to have our cameras on during class. Take Her!!

Professor Secreast is such a sweet, caring lady that knows lots about her subject. She wants her students to succeed and will meet with them during office hours to review their rough draft essays. She will edit your essays in your favor. You will get an A if you ** show up for class, participate, and go to office hours. Great prof! TAKE HER!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters
